dashboard.label: CHIMERA Metrics (Tier 3)
dashboard.description: Tier-3 outcome metrics for the CHIMERA adaptive-deception orchestrator: dwell time, penetration probability, live POMDP belief state, and the headline dwell-uplift comparison (WITH vs WITHOUT CHIMERA). Auto-refresh 30s.

panel.title: THE MONEY CHART — Average Dwell Time: WITH CHIMERA vs WITHOUT

search.query: index=idx_deception type=session_summary synthetic=true scenario IN (baseline_static_honeypot,chimera_adaptive) | eval cohort=case(scenario=="chimera_adaptive","WITH CHIMERA",scenario=="baseline_static_honeypot","WITHOUT (static honeypot)",true(),scenario) | stats avg(dwell_seconds) as "Avg dwell (s)" by cohort | eval "Avg dwell (s)"=round('Avg dwell (s)',0) | sort - "Avg dwell (s)"

index=idx_deception type=session_summary | eval escaped=if(isnull(penetration_escaped),0,penetration_escaped) | stats sum(escaped) as escaped count as total | eval pen_prob=round(if(total=0,0,escaped/total)*100,2) | fields pen_prob

html.div: Definition: penetration_escaped = number of sessions that escalated past honeypot containment. By architecture this is 0 — routed attackers stay inside the deception layer — so the gauge sits in the green range near 0%.

search.query: index=idx_deception type=session_summary synthetic=true scenario=chimera_adaptive | stats avg(dwell_seconds) as v | eval v=round(v,0)
index=idx_deception type=session_summary synthetic=true scenario=baseline_static_honeypot | stats avg(dwell_seconds) as v | eval v=round(v,0)

panel.title: Dwell Time Over Time (avg dwell_seconds per hour, last 24h)

html.div: Plotted on the session's true engagement time (eval _time=ts). Synthetic demo cohorts are spread across the last 24h; any live orchestrator sessions (sub-second FAST seeds) also appear here.

search.query: index=idx_deception type=session_summary NOT scenario IN (probe_test,timecheck,timecheck2) | eval _time=if(isnull(ts),_time,ts) | timechart span=1h avg(dwell_seconds) as "Avg dwell (s)"

panel.title: Live Belief State (latest POMDP action & belief per session)

html.div: From type=deception_action. One row per session showing the most recent POMDP decision: belief over {benign, human, ai} and the chosen breadcrumb intensity (none/subtle/moderate/aggressive).

search.query: index=idx_deception type=deception_action | eval et=if(isnull(ts),_time,ts) | sort 0 - et | dedup session | eval "P(benign)"=round('belief.benign',3), "P(human)"=round('belief.human',3), "P(ai)"=round('belief.ai',3) | eval "last seen"=strftime(et,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table "last seen" src_ip session action "P(benign)" "P(human)" "P(ai)" scenario | sort - "P(ai)"

panel.title: CHIMERA Dwell by Attacker Class (avg dwell_seconds, WITH CHIMERA cohort)

search.query: index=idx_deception type=session_summary synthetic=true scenario=chimera_adaptive | stats avg(dwell_seconds) as "Avg dwell (s)" count as sessions by classification | eval "Avg dwell (s)"=round('Avg dwell (s)',0) | sort - "Avg dwell (s)"
